title: Mastering Figma Workflow & Design System with Kretya Studio
shortTitle: Good design is a system. Not just a screen.
description: Go behind the scenes of a professional design studio. Explore real-world UI/UX workflows and build consistent, scalable interfaces with Figma variables, components, and Auto Layout.
prerequisites: Sign in to your Figma account on a laptop or PC.
Get familiar with frames, basic shapes, and text tools.
Duplicate the starter kit shared with registered participants.
Bring a stable internet connection and a curious mindset.

agenda.title: Welcome & introductions
agenda.description: Meet the community and get ready for the session.

agenda.title: Inside a design studio
agenda.description: Discover professional workflows with the Kretya Studio team.

agenda.title: Build a mini design system
agenda.description: A hands-on exploration of variables, components, and Auto Layout.

agenda.title: Showcase, Q&A & closing
agenda.description: Share your work, ask questions, and wrap up together.

title: Crash Course UI/UX Design
description: Explore user-centered design: the difference between UI and UX, empathy for users, and how designers turn real problems into thoughtful solutions. A community crash course with DSC UHAMKA instructors and a guest practitioner.

title: Data Storytelling: Ultimate Tricks for Data Visualization Using Tableau
shortTitle: Make your data tell a story.
description: Turn spreadsheet rows into clear, interactive stories. Explore Tableau Public, dimensions and measures, charts, maps, and dashboards with Dicky Lihardo Girsang.

speakers.name: Dicky Lihardo Girsang
speakers.role: Data Science Indonesia · Data Analyst Flight at Traveloka

title: Beyond the Surface: Bypassing Defenses & Gaining Persistence
description: A community study jam on web application security with Yumansyah Nurnidar. Explore vulnerability analysis, security testing concepts, and secure coding practices in an educational workshop setting.
location: Lab 1 · FTII UHAMKA Campus F, Ciracas
